properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 in the built dependency tree; no direct first-party call site found. Changeable here via dependency upgrade.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dep of the webpack-dev-server dev-HTTPS toolchain (reached via selfsigned@^1.10.7, yarn.lock:18875); a second copy resolves from node-forge@~0.9.1 at yarn.lock:15080. RSA keygen/PKCS1/OAEP available in the shipped tree for runtime dev-cert generation; no direct RSA call site in application source. Changeable here (lockfile pin/dev toolchain), not app code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency (tweetnacl 0.14.5; a separate tweetnacl@^1.x line resolves at yarn.lock:20553). Ships Ed25519 signatures to the build — quantum-unsafe surface available in the shipped tree. No direct call site found in application source; presence is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Provides the secp256k1 ECDSA that signs every Ethereum transaction the app sends (hardhat tasks, react-app Transactor). Quantum-unsafe signature primitive; changeable here only by moving off Ethereum's secp256k1 curve.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic ships in the app bundle via ethers v5, which packages/react-app (^5.4.1, package.json:39) and packages/hardhat (^5.4.4, package.json:24) declare directly. The ECDSA/secp256k1 side of elliptic is the surface the app actually exercises (transaction signing); this ECDH surface is available in the shipped tree with no direct call site found in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive crypto dependency; X25519 scalar-multiplication key agreement available in the shipped tree. No direct call site found in application source. Quantum-unsafe key establishment available to the build, worth tracking for when it gains a call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Same node-forge copies as ALG-589856a1 (webpack-dev-server dev-HTTPS cert toolchain). AES block-cipher available in the shipped tree; no direct call site in application source. AES is PQ-safe as a primitive (Grover only halves the key space), so this is a version/pin concern, not a migration one.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: KDF dependency of the ethers v5 keystore-encryption path; no direct first-party call site found in this repo.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Password KDF for Ethereum encrypted JSON keystores: scrypt-js@3.x (yarn.lock:18825) is pulled by ethers v5, which both app workspaces depend on directly, so the build can derive wallet keys from passphrases. scrypt-js@2.0.4 (yarn.lock:18820) is the second resolved copy (pre-ethers toolchain). KDF parameters are chosen inside ethers' keystore code, not in this repo's source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AE primitive in the shipped tree via the tweetnacl dependency. PQ-safe symmetric crypto — no migration needed. No direct call site found in application source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Transitive dep of webpack-dev-server, used to mint the self-signed dev HTTPS certificate for the react-app dev server (cert + signing key generated at runtime by node-forge). Dev-toolchain asset, changeable here. Self-signed certs imply the dev server's browser trust story (accept-and-continue) rather than a real PKI — practice posture worth recording.

properties.name: pqs:context
